subject: Refund request: Purchased annual Pro subscription 10 days ago
draft_reply:
Subject: Re: Refund request – Annual Pro subscription (TKT-006)

Hi there,

Thank you for reaching out, and I completely understand — choosing the right tool for your team is a big decision, and I'm sorry FlowBoard wasn't the right fit alongside your existing Jira setup.

The good news is that you are well within our **14-day money-back guarantee** for first-time annual Pro subscriptions. I have processed a **full refund** to the original payment method on file. Please allow some time for the funds to appear on your statement, as processing times can vary by bank.

If you don't see the refund reflected in your account, or if there's anything else I can help with, just reply to this ticket and I'll take care of it right away.

Best regards,
FlowBoard Support Team
